recentItems.title: Yamagola Malli Modalaindi Telugu Full Length Movie | Srikanth, Venu, Reemasen | Shalimar Cinema
recentItems.description:
Yamagola Malli Modalaindi is a hilarious Telugu socio-fantasy comedy starring Srikanth, Meera Jasmine, Venu and Reema Sen in the lead roles.

The story revolves around Yama and Chitragupta, who decide to retire from their duties and send their successors, Junior Yama and Junior Chitragupta, to Earth on an important mission. Their assignment takes an unexpected turn when Junior Yama falls in love with Aishwarya, the very person whose life he has been sent to take. Meanwhile, Junior Chitragupta falls for police officer Vaijayanti.

What follows is a fun-filled combination of comedy, romance, fantasy, Yamaloka episodes and entertaining twists. The film also features veteran actor Kaikala Satyanarayana as Yama, connecting the movie with the classic Yamagola.

recentItems.description:
అంకుశం | Ankusham | Telugu Best Scenes | Rajasekhar | Jeevitha | Rami Reddy | Kodi Ramakrishna

Ankusham is a classic Telugu action drama directed by Kodi Ramakrishna and produced by M. Shyam Prasad Reddy. The film stars Dr. Rajasekhar, Jeevitha and Rami Reddy in prominent roles, with music composed by Chellapilla Satyam. 

The story follows an honest and determined police officer who takes on a powerful criminal and fights against corruption and injustice. When the criminal threatens the Chief Minister, the police officer stands between the conspiracy and his mentor, leading to a series of intense confrontations and emotional twists.

The movie became a major breakthrough in Rajasekhar's career and is remembered particularly for his powerful police-role performance and Rami Reddy's villainous character. It was also a box-office success and received three Nandi Awards.

🔥 Watch the Best Scenes from Ankusham and revisit one of Telugu cinema's memorable action classics!
